simple.meaning: צָעָה (tsâʻâh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to tip over (for the purpose of spilling or pouring out), i.e. (figuratively) depopulate ; by implication, to imprison or conquer ; (reflexive) to lie down (for coitus).” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 5 times in Isaiah, Jeremiah, beginning at Isaiah 51:14. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צָעָה (H6808) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: צָעָה (tsâʻâh) / H6808 is traced through Isaiah 51:14, Isaiah 63:1, Jeremiah 2:20, Jeremiah 48:12 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.short: to tip over (for the purpose of spilling or pouring out), i.e. (figuratively) depopulate ; by implication, to imprison or conquer ; (reflexive) to lie down (for coitus)
definitions.full: H6808. tsaah [ צָעָה ] verb stoop, bend, incline (Arabic (, ) incline, lean , compare also ); — Qal Participle 1 צֹעֶה Isa 51:14 one stooping (under a burden), 63:1 bending (forward or backward; from abundant strength), but read probably צֹעֵד marching (Lo Gr Che Du Di-Kit and others); feminine זֹּנָה צֹעָה אַתְּ Jer 2:20 (in sensu obscoeno). 2 transitive (= Pi`el q. v.) plural צֹעִים Jer 48:12 men inclining, tipping a vessel, to empty it. Pi`el Perfect 3plural suffix וְצֵעֻהוּ Jer 48:12 I will send tippers and they shall tip him over (Moab, under figure of vessel).
